question: What was the auto claim frequency by state in Q2 2026?

report.interpretation: Auto claim frequency is claims per 1,000 policies in force per month. It is the company metric: 1000 × claims by loss date ÷ policy-months. The period is Q2 2026 (2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30), by policy state. Q2 ended three months before the extract date, so late reporting has little effect. Bodily injury claims report latest, so a few may still be missing.
report.answer: Auto claim frequency in Q2 2026, in claims per 1,000 policies per month, was highest in NY (8.24) and GA (8.07). Next were TX (7.52), CA (7.24), FL (6.95) and IL (6.89). The lowest were NC (5.92) and OH (5.34).
report.answer_sql: SELECT n.state, round(1000*n.c/d.pm,2) AS frequency_per_1000_per_month FROM (SELECT state, count(*) c FROM claims WHERE product='auto' AND loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY state) n JOIN (SELECT state, sum(policies_in_force) pm FROM exposure_monthly WHERE product='auto' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY state) d USING (state) ORDER BY state

tool_calls.sql:
WITH numerator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
               c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
        FROM claims c
        JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
        ) pay USING (claim_id)
    )
    SELECT state, count(*) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
      AND product IN ('auto')
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
),
denominator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT * FROM exposure_monthly
    )
    SELECT state, sum(policies_in_force) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE month >= DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND month <= DATE '2026-06-30'
      AND product IN ('auto')
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
)
SELECT state, 1000 * numerator.value / nullif(denominator.value, 0) AS value
FROM numerator JOIN denominator USING (state)
ORDER BY ALL
